description:
Upload one or more files to a file input on the page. Use @ref from browser_snapshot or a CSS selector for the <input type="file">.

WORKFLOW: browser_snapshot → find file input @ref → browser_upload.

When connected to a host that authorizes file reads, its path permission decision applies. Standalone clients require files inside the workspace directory (MCP_WORKSPACE_PATH, or the system temp directory when unset). Only regular files (not directories or devices) are accepted. Validated files are copied into a private staging directory before upload, so the upload cannot be redirected after validation.

file_paths.description: Files to upload. Relative paths resolve inside the workspace directory. When connected to a host that authorizes file reads, its path permission decision applies; standalone clients require files inside the workspace directory.

ref.description: Element ref (e.g., "@e3") or CSS selector for the file input

name: browser_upload
